card.summary: Lets an agent remember earlier conversations, so people do not have to repeat themselves.
card.example: A returning person carries on with an earlier case without restating the details.
cost: Billed for how much the database is used, either as reserved capacity or per request.
Stored conversations also add a storage charge.
needs: A decision on how long conversations are kept.
A way to delete the history of anyone who asks.
card.safety: It would store what people type, so it needs retention and deletion rules before it is used.
card.billing: Provisioned or serverless request units, plus storage.
